## Library concepts in the downloadable pack

- mohawk/knife street fighter — dedicated side-view walking row
- four-direction knife fighter — explicit left/right side poses
- rugged brawler — side-angled move, attack, hit and KO material
- dreadlocked fighter — side movement and fighting poses
- white-suit heavy boss — profile walking cycle
- Alepa wanderer — explicit full-body profile and clothing/prop references
- broad neon-alley/TURF rosters — identity and silhouette mining
- rogue turnaround — four-angle conversion reference

## Production selection rule

Prioritize strong profile readability, clear leg opposition, horizontal weapon silhouettes, useful hair/clothing trailing motion, and Kallio street identity. Rebuild final sprites against Slay Kallio's own camera and baseline rather than inheriting TURF's isometric rules.
